notes: Removed the Stocks tab: paper-trading stocks isn't budgeting, and this app shouldn't look like investing advice. Your pay-stub stock lines (company stock contribution, stock purchase) are untouched — those are real paycheck math.

Trimmed the Discounts tab: the deal-search links, cashback-service explainers, and cashback estimator are gone, along with a Refresh button that never actually refreshed anything. What stays: your deal watchlist, the student-discount directory, and the discount calculator (now in Calculators).
Trimmed the Calculators tab: split-a-bill and tip math are gone — restaurant math isn't budgeting. Unit-price comparison stays.
New on the Budget tab: a due-soon line under Bills due — anything unpaid and overdue, plus what's due in the next 7 days, so a due date can't sneak up on you.
